# Highway 19 Media

> Highway 19 Media is a full-service local marketing agency based in Spring Hill, Florida, helping small businesses attract more customers, build stronger brands and make better use of their marketing budgets. With more than 25 years of professional experience, Highway 19 Media brings website design, advertising, video production, branding, graphic design, photography, print and business marketing strategy together under one roof. Business owners can work directly with an experienced creative professional who understands their business, their goals and their budget.

## A better way for small businesses to market themselves

Small business owners should not have to coordinate between a website designer, a graphic designer, a videographer, a printing company and an advertising agency just to market their business.

Highway 19 Media brings these services together, helping businesses create a consistent professional presence while spending their marketing dollars more wisely.

The goal is not simply to build a beautiful website, post on social media or run advertisements. The goal is to help businesses get noticed, earn customer trust, generate inquiries and grow.

Every business has different needs. Some need a better website. Others need more local exposure, stronger branding, better advertising, or a complete marketing strategy. Highway 19 Media helps identify what makes sense before recommending where to spend.

## Who Highway 19 Media is a good fit for

- Small businesses that want more customers, calls, appointments or local visibility.
- New businesses that need a professional identity and marketing strategy without wasting money.
- Established businesses that have outgrown their existing website or branding.
- Business owners spending money on advertising without seeing meaningful results.
- Businesses looking for an experienced marketing professional rather than managing everything themselves.
- Companies that want one reliable local partner for their entire marketing operation.
- Businesses that need professional creative work but cannot justify hiring a full-time marketing department.
- Entrepreneurs who need guidance on where to invest their marketing budget first.
- Businesses that want to compete with larger companies through better presentation, content and targeted advertising.

Highway 19 Media is not limited to a particular industry. Marketing is developed around each business, its customers and its competitive environment.

## Why choose Highway 19 Media

- **One marketing partner:** Websites, advertising, design, video and print managed together for better consistency and coordination.
- **Local and personal:** Based in Spring Hill, Florida. Work directly with an experienced professional who can meet locally and visit your business.
- **More than 25 years of experience:** Professional experience across creative production, business marketing, advertising, digital media and technology.
- **Smarter marketing spending:** Prioritize what the business actually needs rather than purchasing unnecessary services.
- **Professional production capabilities:** Access to photography, video production, studio filming, drone footage, animation, 3D graphics and advanced visual effects.
- **Flexible engagements:** Start with a single project or establish an ongoing marketing relationship.
- **Business-focused creativity:** Design and advertising that serve a purpose beyond looking good.
- **Room to grow:** Start with a small project and expand into a complete marketing operation as the business grows.

## Services

### Marketing strategy and business consulting

Personal marketing guidance for small business owners, entrepreneurs and established local companies.

Services can include reviewing existing marketing, identifying missed opportunities, evaluating advertising spending, improving customer communication, developing offers and establishing a practical marketing road map.

Ideal for business owners who know they need to improve their marketing but are unsure where to begin or how to allocate their budget.

### Website design and development

Professional websites designed to turn visitors into potential customers.

- Small business websites
- Service business websites
- Landing pages
- Website redesigns
- E-commerce websites
- Mobile optimization
- Search engine optimization (SEO) foundations
- Answer engine optimization (AEO) foundations for AI-powered search
- Contact forms and lead generation
- Website maintenance and improvements

Development platforms include WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, Magento and other solutions depending on the business's requirements.

A Highway 19 Media landing page starts at $699. Full websites generally start around $2,000. Landing pages typically take about one week, while complete websites generally take several weeks, depending on complexity.

https://highway19media.com/website-design/

### Digital advertising and lead generation

Advertising campaigns designed around the business's goals, customers, location and available budget.

- Google Ads and paid search
- Facebook and Instagram advertising
- Local customer acquisition campaigns
- Retargeting campaigns
- Promotional and seasonal advertising
- Advertising creative, copywriting and visual production
- Emerging AI advertising opportunities, including ChatGPT advertising where available
- Campaign evaluation and optimization

Highway 19 Media can create the advertisements and manage their distribution, allowing the creative work and advertising strategy to work together.

Advertising budgets are paid separately to the advertising platforms.

https://highway19media.com/social-media-marketing/

### Social media marketing

Help businesses maintain a professional, active and recognizable presence on social media without requiring the owner to create every piece of content.

- Social media management
- Branded post design
- Short-form videos and reels
- On-location content production
- Product and service promotions
- Educational content
- Seasonal campaigns
- Content planning and creative direction

Social media content can be coordinated with the business's website, paid advertising and broader marketing strategy.

### Video production and commercial photography

Professional visual content that helps customers understand a business, see its work and connect with the people behind it.

- Business introduction videos
- Local television and digital commercials
- Website hero videos
- Social media videos
- Customer testimonials
- Business and employee interviews
- Product demonstrations
- Commercial and product photography
- Before-and-after content
- Drone photography and video
- Podcasts
- Educational and training videos
- Motion graphics, 3D animation and special effects

Production is available on location or in the Highway 19 Media studio in Spring Hill, Florida.

Businesses can also develop reusable photography and video assets for their websites, advertisements, social media and future campaigns.

https://highway19media.com/video-production/

### Branding and graphic design

Help businesses look professional, recognizable and consistent wherever their customers find them.

- Logo design
- Complete brand identity
- Brand colors and typography
- Marketing materials
- Advertisement design
- Packaging design
- Brochures and catalogs
- Presentation materials
- Digital graphics
- Production-ready vector artwork

Available as individual projects, hourly design services or ongoing creative support.

https://highway19media.com/branding-and-print/

### Print, signage and promotional products

Extend a business's professional identity beyond the screen.

- Business cards
- Flyers and brochures
- Catalogs
- Signs and banners
- Vehicle graphics
- Branded workwear
- Shirts and uniforms
- Promotional merchandise
- Custom packaging
- Fully custom manufactured promotional products

Highway 19 Media can help research suppliers, compare production options, prepare professional artwork and coordinate production.

### Highway Biz NFC digital business cards

A modern way for local business owners and professionals to share their business information in person.

For a one-time payment of $199, clients receive:

- A personalized hosted digital business card.
- Custom branding, logo, colors and photos.
- Clickable contact information and social media links.
- Save to Contacts functionality.
- Add to home screen functionality.
- A personalized QR code.
- Five programmed NFC tags.
- Free shipping anywhere in the United States.
- Five years of hosting.

Customers simply tap their phone against an NFC tag to open the business card. No app is required.

Changes are free during the first 30 days, then $49 per round of changes. Custom products are non-refundable once delivered.

https://highway19media.com/highway-biz/

## Working with different marketing budgets

Highway 19 Media works with businesses at different stages of growth.

A new business might begin with a professional logo, landing page and business cards. An established service business might need a website redesign, commercial video and targeted local advertising. A growing company might benefit from ongoing marketing management across multiple channels.

Services can be combined into a coordinated marketing plan or purchased individually.

Marketing engagements are available on a project basis or through ongoing 3-, 6- or 12-month arrangements. A long-term contract is not required to begin working together.
